critical_route_boxes.policy: suppress inherited/default pools and use compiled route pools
critical_route_boxes.native_expression: every inherited spawn_pool_world file overridden at its resource path; each spawn detail gains one {minX,maxX,minZ,maxZ} entry per route box in "anticonditions" (plural key; singular "anticondition" with an array aborts the reload)
critical_route_boxes.generator: tools/suppress_inherited_spawns.py --boxes merged --grid 16 (637 boxes; output build/datapacks/cobblers_suppress/, upstream data, never committed)
critical_route_boxes.runtime_status: proven 2026-09-17 on a disposable world: corridor sample 54% -> 97.6% curated, outside unchanged; 1,729 files, 368 MB, +8 s boot, +1.5 GB heap, +8.5 s reload, no measurable tick cost

habitat_blocks.policy: ReplaceSpawns=true inside each placed Natural Habitat Block influence
habitat_blocks.native_support: HabitatBlockEntity natural style: ReplaceSpawns, RangeOfInfluence, PoolId; found by the vanilla POI manager
habitat_blocks.runtime_status: proven 2026-09-17 (EXP-021): replaces the ambient pool; edge at the configured range; survives chunk reload and restart; lost on re-export unless the chunk is transplanted or the block re-placed; overlapping ReplaceSpawns ranges spawn nothing; command-placed blocks activate after one chunk reload; vertical reach and fishing untested

marine_zones.policy: suppress inherited/default pools over every marine band box and use the compiled marine pools
marine_zones.native_expression: the same per-detail coordinate anticonditions as the route and sub-region boxes; the band boxes join the box set before merging
marine_zones.generator: tools/suppress_inherited_spawns.py --subregions (the band boxes come from tools/compile_spawns.py marine_bands, so the suppressed area and the compiled marine pools are the same boxes)
marine_zones.why: the owner, 2026-09-26, about 300 blocks off the west shore in deep_ocean: 'i dont think it should be magikarps and small frys'. No roster reached that water, so the pack's own ocean pools ran there: Cobblemon's Magikarp herd (weight 59.4) and single (6.9, 1-20), Wishiwashi's herd (100) and single (10, 1-18), and Relicanth's herd (1000) in the common bucket. Added beside our rosters instead of suppressed, those weights would swamp them
marine_zones.box_count: 111 marine band boxes at the 32-block grid; merged with the rest at grid 16 the whole suppression set is 931 boxes (939 without them: the sea is simpler than the coast it fills in)
marine_zones.runtime_status: not installed; generated only against an empty server directory to count boxes (2026-09-26)

retain_defaults: open ocean outside authored sites and marine_zones
postgame unless later progression policy changes it

removed_species.policy: never wild, anywhere: every inherited spawn detail naming one of these species is removed from the inherited pools in every dimension, inside and outside every box; retain_defaults does not keep them
removed_species.why: the owner, 2026-10-08: 'WILD FLUTTER MANE: switch the inherited paradox spawns off. Paradoxes are dungeon content, and a wild one in spooky biomes at night undoes both that and the starter being special. Check every other paradox while you are there.' Flutter Mane is the final of the eighth starter line (data/mythical_starters.json starter_misdreavus). Dungeon paradoxes come from dungeon data, not from wild pools
removed_species.species_source: the 20 species the Cobblemon 1.8.0 jar labels 'paradox' (data/cobblemon/species/generation9/), plus Koraidon and Miraidon (labelled legendary, restricted, not paradox); tools/suppress_inherited_spawns.py fails closed if the jar it reads labels a paradox this list lacks
removed_species.native_expression: tools/suppress_inherited_spawns.py drops every detail whose pokemon (or herd member) is listed from the file it re-emits; a file left with no detail is re-emitted as the inherited file with "enabled": false (EXP-012 V4 and V5: disabling a jar file and a COBBLEVERSE-DP file by path, proven 2026-09-17). Generated at install with the rest of the pack, so it reaches whatever upstream spawn files the server actually loads
removed_species.inherited_sources_2026-10-08: COBBLEVERSE-DP-v31.zip data/cobblemon/spawn_pool_world/<dex>_<species>.json, one file each for all 22 and the only wild source; measured over the snapshot cobblers-local/server-snapshot-2026-10-05 (every mod jar, nested pack and datapack, structure .nbt decompressed): no Cobblemon-jar, mod, LegendaryMonuments, habitat_pools or extra/ region-pack spawn names one. Not spawns: the DP's cobblemonraiddens raid bosses (Raid Dens is not installed), RCT trainer teams (kanto_league_agatha's Flutter Mane; three Team Galactic grunts), the Paldea dex, LumyMon's snack blacklist
removed_species.fail_closed: tools/suppress_inherited_spawns.py verify_removed_species: after writing, every inherited resource path the server loads is re-read from its effective source and the pack's output, and the run fails if any still-enabled file names a listed species (tests/test_suppress_removed_species.py)
removed_species.not_covered: a Pokemon a trainer, a scripted event, a starter grant or a player puts in the world; our own compiled pools are checked separately (tools/validate_data.py check wild-paradox)

spawn_free_zones.why: the owner, 2026-09-21: nothing wanders the champion's approach. The League moved onto the Rift's apex oval on 2026-09-23 and this box did NOT move with it: until 2026-09-23 it still covered the trunk-head floor at [3496, 2568, 3655, 2783], which is empty ground now, and left the lot and the approach open. It is the League's lot (data/rift_league_tunnel.json) with 16 blocks round it, snapped out to the 8-block grid the route boxes share, and it takes in Victory Road's exit onto the apron.
spawn_free_zones.mechanism: tools/compile_spawns.py cuts it out of every route, sub-region and waterway pool, and tools/suppress_inherited_spawns.py adds it to the inherited pools' anticondition boxes, so neither the campaign's rosters nor Cobblemon's and Cobbleverse's defaults spawn inside it
spawn_free_zones.not_covered: Pokemon a player sends out, and anything a trainer spawner or scripted event puts there

spawn_free_zones.why: the owner, 2026-09-21: no wild Pokemon wanders into a leader battle, whatever the gym's theme. The box was Brock's gym (gym1_brock_gym, as placed) with 2 blocks round it, snapped out to the 8-block grid the route boxes share: [1808, 3664, 1847, 3695]. Widened south to 3711 on 2026-09-29 for the gym's carved interior (data/gym_interiors.json gym1): the boxes are x/z only, four numbers and all y, so the dig is covered as long as its x/z stays inside, and the pit and the foreman's room run to z3703, past the old edge. Contract G1. Snapped out to the 8-block grid on 2026-09-30: growing it to hold the authored building put it off the grid and tools/suppress_inherited_spawns.py fail-closed on "box [1807, 3657, 1847, 3711] is not on the 8-block grid" at install. The grid is the subregion grid the suppression writes on, so a box has to be whole 8-blocks; snapping OUTWARD only ever suppresses more.
spawn_free_zones.not_covered: Pokemon a player sends out, and the gym's own trainers
spawn_free_zones.why_2026_09_29: grown to hold the authored gym building, which is larger than the donor shell and the dig it replaces. The emitted extent is [1809, 3659, 1843, 3700]; the box keeps 2 blocks beyond it on every side. Measured from the commands tools/gym_buildings.py emits, not from the gym's own record.
